email.email_verification.body:
Hello,

To verify the email address of your Storycreep account at {site}, open this link within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}:

{url}

If you did not create an account at {site}, you can ignore this email.
email.email_verification.subject: Verify your email address for Storycreep
email.invite.body:
Hello,

You have been invited to join a workspace of Storycreep at {site} as {role, select, owner {an owner} admin {an admin} editor {an editor} commenter {a commenter} viewer {a viewer} other {a guest}}. To accept, open this link within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, and sign in with an account of this email address, or create one with it if the server takes new accounts:

{url}

If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
email.invite.subject: You are invited to a Storycreep workspace
email.password_reset.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the password of your Storycreep account at {site}. To choose a new password, open this link within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It works once, and signs your account out everywhere:

{url}

If it was not you, you can ignore this email, and your password stays as it is.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Storycreep password
error.already_member: This account is a member of the workspace already.
error.board_referenced: Jumpers on other boards lead to this board. Confirm to delete it all the same, and leave them broken.
error.branch_output_connected: Connections leave this output. Confirm to delete it all the same, with its connections.
error.component_in_use: Parts of the project use this component. Delete it anyway only if you mean to break them, which needs a role that may publish.
error.component_type_in_use: Components of this type are not all in the trash. Delete them first.
error.csrf_failed: The request lacks the session's CSRF token, or came from another origin.
error.email_configured: This server emails its links to each account's own address, so it gives none as text.
error.email_not_configured: This server does not send email. Ask an instance admin for the link instead.
error.email_unverified: Verify your email address first, with the link that was emailed to you.
error.folder_not_empty: This folder still holds folders, boards, variables, or components. Move them out of it, or delete them, first.
error.idempotency_mismatch: Some of these changes were saved already and others were not, so none of them was saved.
error.image_invalid: The file is not an image that can be uploaded.
error.image_invalid.dimensions: The image is too large: it may have at most {pixels, number} pixels, and {side, number} on each side.
error.image_invalid.malformed: The file starts like an image, but it is damaged.
error.image_invalid.type: The file is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or SVG image.
error.image_invalid.unsupported: The SVG image is not damaged, but the server does not take it: it is not in UTF-8, or its elements nest too deeply, or it has too many attributes or entities.
error.instance_admin_required: Only an instance admin may do this.
error.insufficient_role: Your role does not allow this.
error.insufficient_scope: This API token does not hold the scope that this needs.
error.invalid_credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
error.invalid_id.character: The identifier contains a character outside Crockford base32.
error.invalid_id.length: The part of the identifier after its prefix is not {length} characters long.
error.invalid_id.missing_prefix: The identifier has no type prefix.
error.invalid_id.overflow: The part of the identifier after its prefix does not fit in 128 bits.
error.invalid_id.unknown_prefix: The identifier's type prefix is unknown.
error.invalid_id.wrong_prefix: The identifier's prefix {prefix}_ is for type {got}, not {expected}.
error.invalid_setup_code: The setup code is wrong. The server writes it to its log while setup is pending.
error.invite_accepted: This invitation has been accepted already.
error.invite_email_mismatch: This invitation is for another email address. Use the account of that address.
error.invite_exists: This email address has an open invitation to the workspace already. Send that one again instead.
error.invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the workspace's admin to send it again.
error.invite_required: Registration on this server needs an invitation.
error.key_invalid: A key must be at most 64 ASCII letters, digits, and underscores, not start with a digit, and not be a reserved word.
error.key_taken: Something else has this key already.
error.last_owner: A workspace keeps an owner, so its last owner cannot be removed or demoted. Make another member an owner first.
error.limit_exceeded: This would take the workspace past one of its limits.
error.limit_exceeded.key: {key, select, members {This would take the workspace past its limit of {limit, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}.} projects {This would take the workspace past its limit of {limit, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}.} storage_bytes {This would take the workspace past its storage limit of {limit, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}}.} other {This would take the workspace past its limit of {limit, number} for {key}.}}
error.method_not_allowed: The method is not allowed for this resource.
error.not_ready.database_unreachable: The server cannot reach its database.
error.not_ready.migrations_pending: The database has pending migrations, which storycreep migrate applies.
error.owner_not_grantable: A project grant cannot make someone an owner. Choose admin, editor, commenter, or viewer.
error.owner_required: Only an owner of this workspace may do this.
error.project_archived: This project is archived, so it cannot be changed. Unarchive it first.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
error.rate_limited.locked: Too many failed sign-ins with this email address. Try again later.
error.request_timeout: The request body did not arrive in time.
error.request_too_large: The request body is too large.
error.revision_conflict: This has changed since you last saw it, so nothing was changed.
error.session_required: This needs you to sign in. An API token cannot do it.
error.setup_required: This server's first-run setup has not been completed yet.
error.signup_closed: Registration is closed on this server.
error.slug_invalid: The slug must be lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens, and not a reserved word.
error.storage_limit_exceeded: This file would take the workspace past its storage limit.
error.storage_limit_exceeded.limit: This file would take the workspace past its storage limit of {limit, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}}.
error.token_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.token_invalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
error.token_used: This link has been used already. Ask for a new one.
error.unsupported_media_type: The request body is not in a supported format.
error.variable_in_use: Parts of the project use this variable. Delete it anyway only if you mean to break them, which needs a role that may publish.
error.weak_password.common: The password is one of the most common passwords.
error.weak_password.too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
validation.board_entry_missing: This board has no entry node, and {roots, plural, other {# nodes}} where the flow could start, which no connection enters. Mark one as its entry.
validation.branch_no_outputs: This branch has no outputs, so the flow always ends here.
validation.choice_duplicate_label: An earlier choice of this node has the same label, and their conditions may both hold, so the player sees the same choice twice.
validation.connection_parallel: An earlier connection leaves the same port for the same node.
validation.connection_self: This connection leads back to the node that it leaves.
validation.dead_end: No connection leaves this element, and it is not marked as an ending, so the flow stops here.
validation.expr_invalid: This expression does not compile ({error}), so it is kept but does nothing until it is fixed.
validation.jumper_broken: {reason, select, none {This jumper has no target.} other {This jumper's target was deleted.}}
validation.jumper_invalid: {reason, select, target {This jumper leads to another jumper, which a jumper may not.} other {Connections leave this jumper, which a jumper may not have.}}
validation.node_empty: This element has no text, and no connection leaves it.
validation.node_unreachable: The flow never reaches this node from the entry of any board, whatever the conditions.
validation.port_unconnected: No connection leaves this output, so the flow ends here when the branch picks it.
validation.ref_dangling: {reason, select, scope {This shows a variable of another board, which only that board can read.} runtime {This shows a component's attribute that is not runtime, which the game's state does not hold.} other {This refers to {target, select, variable {a variable} attribute {a component's attribute} component {a component} node {a node} board {a board} other {something}} that was deleted, or that does not exist.}}
validation.speaker_missing: This line of dialogue has no speaker.
validation.var_read_never_written: The variable {key} is read, but nothing assigns it, so it always holds its default.
validation.var_written_never_read: The variable {key} is assigned, but nothing reads it.
